LanguageData.SE_RegenesisComa.label: regenerative coma
LanguageData.SE_RegenesisComa.description: Regenerative mechanites have rendered this person unconscious while they repair damaged tissue. When the treatment ends, they will attempt to repair a permanent injury on an existing body part.
LanguageData.SE_AdvancedRegenesisComa.label: advanced regenerative coma
LanguageData.SE_AdvancedRegenesisComa.description: Regenerative mechanites have rendered this person unconscious while they rebuild lost tissue. When the treatment ends, they will attempt to restore a missing biological part or repair a permanent injury.
